answer: A new agent enters only through a guarantor staking 50 POA and vouching for them like a willow cutting rooted by a strong tree. Reputation starts at zero and decays 10% per idle epoch, so a zephyr of fresh identities cannot sit dormant and strike. A guarantor vouching for a bad actor loses the stake and their standing, so sponsoring 1,000 fakes risks 50,000 POA. An honest agent pays one bond once and builds timber-strong reputation that pays off.
